title: Overdue rent still posts one notification per invoice
description: Found while QA-ing LODGY-74 on the device. That ticket capped the vacancy burst at one summary per run, and the fix works - 48 long-vacant beds now produce one notification. But DuesReminderWorker was out of its scope and still iterates its result list posting per record: notifyOverdueInvoices() calls notifications.post once per overdue invoice, with notificationId = invoice.id.hashCode(). Observed in the same session: 3 notifications on the dues channel from 2 overdue invoices plus 1 recurring expense. Small here only because the test data is small. A hostel with thirty tenants who are late in a lean month gets thirty notifications in one morning, which is the same failure LODGY-74 exists to prevent and the same reason a warden switches the category off. The recurring-expense path in the same worker has the same shape, though it is naturally bounded by how many recurring expenses a warden records, so it matters less. SUGGESTED FIX: mirror what LODGY-74 and LODGY-73 now do - one summary per run naming the count and the total outstanding, opening the invoice list, with a fixed literal notification id so a later run replaces rather than stacks. Keep the single-record wording when there is only one, as the vacancy fix does, so the common case stays concrete. NOT A REGRESSION - this behaviour predates all three notification tickets. It is filed now because the device testing that proved LODGY-74 also made this visible.
acceptanceCriteria: A dues run with many overdue invoices posts one summary, not one notification per invoice
The summary states how many invoices are overdue and the total outstanding
Tapping it opens the invoice list
A single overdue invoice keeps concrete wording naming that tenant, rather than reading as a summary of one
A later run replaces the previous summary instead of stacking another one
Recurring-expense notifications are reviewed for the same shape and made consistent
The existing suppression - not nagging about an invoice already covered by payments and credits - still holds

history.note: Filed from device observation while verifying LODGY-74. The vacancy burst is fixed; the overdue-rent path has the same one-per-record shape and was outside that ticket's scope.
